entrypoints.description: Repository-owned orchestration spec composes existing Evidence/Reality executors and preserved-source integrity guards.
Existing longcycle research command surface delegates to the shared orchestration application logic.

extension_seams: Add researcher/task invocation adapters by delegation to the same application contract.
Add new bounded execution phases only when an existing semantic executor already owns the phase.

Historical-recovery discovery stays upstream in CAP-0006; compose only source material that CAP-0001/CAP-0002 have truthfully preserved and grounded. Raw-file materialization is optional unless the claim specifically requires byte-level/source-format verification.

guards.description: Contract tests cover preserved source-material hashes, repair guards and immutable paths.

non_goals: Owning GitHub Release/Drive transport restoration or PDF download machinery.
Owning memory-first historical discovery or treating one execution entrypoint as the whole historical-research lifecycle.
Requiring raw source packs when claim-relevant content is already truthfully content_verified under CAP-0001/CAP-0002.
Campaign-specific branches in the generic runner.
purpose: Own execution-stage composition of preserved source-material verification, explicit repair overlay, Grounded Evidence execution, optional Reality projection and immutable-path guards. It consumes CAP-0001/CAP-0002 source/Evidence state and must not turn raw-byte acquisition into an independent research prerequisite.
revisit_when: Only replace if source identity, representation integrity, repair auditability, fail-closed phase composition, immutable guards and portable receipts remain one campaign-agnostic execution contract without absorbing historical discovery or transport semantics.
title: Fail-closed research orchestration
